scope: All saved944 sessions per parent, same control and candidate, no cross-parent performance ranking. Existing tail scoring reused. All annual, quarterly and every contiguous126session window; boundary periods explicitly partial. Development diagnosis only; parent routes remain closed.
method: For every session use actual saved native posttrade holdings and raw marks over open09:47 to recovery10:32, recovery to saved close (half-days preserved), overnight close to next09:45, next09:45 to next09:47 pretrade. Adjust overnight raw return for split ratio and ex-date income; payment transfers receivables to cash without income. Sum actual segment dollar P&L divided by start-of-session NAV minus actual saved fees closes saved native daily return at 1e-9. For each asset/slot, sum(w*r)=N*mean(w)*mean(r)+N*population_cov(w,r); aggregate contribution arithmetic, never call it compounded counterfactual. Report candidate-minus-control component differences within each parent.
raw_controller: Saved raw model target versus final opening target weight difference; actual holdings weights separately. No controller-off counterfactual, no causal attribution.
states: Market state only saved prior signal soxx_trend20 positive/nonpositive; account state saved risk_state is endogenous and descriptive. Ex post window winners never feature input.
failure: Missing native objects, identity mismatch, calendar mismatch, nonfinite returns, NAV/P&L closure failure abort; no backtest or model fallback.
promotion: No promotion claim or fresh evidence; unchanged gates and existing parent reference comparisons.
cash_events_costs: Only each parent saved inputs/schedule, inputs/raw_points, inputs/execution_plan and native book orders/receipts. Zero external refresh. Cash interest is zero under inherited parent convention; receivable payment only transfers assets. Preserve saved IBKR tariff and independently settled0/2/5bp accounts; reconstruct total actual saved order fee including slippage, no alternate costs. Corporate split/exdate timing inherited unchanged; historical_PIT_qualified=false, fullminute_risk_qualified=false, independent_development=false, qualified_forward=false.
